name: Area
flavor: Area spells affects multiple tiles in a area

name: Conjured Weapon
flavor: The spell creates a weapon out magic that the caster can use while they maintain the spell

name: Complex
flavor: Complex spells are are harder to cast, requiring cunning and deftness

name: Dimensional
flavor: The spell has to do with shaping or manipulating dimensional rifts and extra dimensional spaces

name: Draining
effect: Increase the spells mana cost by twice its rank
flavor: Draining spells require a lot of mana

name: Enchantment
flavor: The spell temporarily improves the caster or target, or gives them new abilities

name: Environmental
flavor: The spell affects a large area, causing an effect on the environment

name: Illusion
flavor: The spell creates an illusory shape to fool visual observers

name: Manipulation
flavor: Manipulation spells modifies or shapes matter. They are generally not cast in combat

name: Movement
flavor: The spell gives the caster new ways to move or improves their current movement speed.

name: Precision
effect: When targeting weak points the penalty is 2 lower than normal (to a minimum of 1)
flavor: These spells are very precise, allowing you to target creature weak points easier

name: Sensing
flavor: The spell helps the caster detect things

name: Soul
flavor: The spell targets or affects souls

name: Targeting
effect: You can make targeted attacks with the spell, it also counts as an attack for the purposes of your multiple attack penalty
flavor: Targeting spells fire one or multiple projectiles

name: Teleportation
flavor: Allows the caster to instantly move to a new position

name: Temporal
flavor: Deals with time, speed up or slowing down objects or creatures
